items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: I had Butch Ballard on drums, George Rhodes on piano and Poor Jumpin' George Jones on -- I mean Walter Buchanan on bass. Poor George came in later.

ctx.x: Who'd you have on rhythm then?
I had Butch Ballard on drums, George Rhodes on piano and Poor Jumpin' George Jones on -- I mean Walter Buchanan on bass. Poor George came in later.
